Claimants.
Mr. Dashrath Prajapati, Advocate for respondents No. 4 and 5/Driver & Owner.
Heard on I.A. No. 02/2025, application for condonation of delay in filing the appeal.
Learned counsel for the appellant would submit that the award was passed on 17.09.2024 by the learned IV th Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raipur, District Raipur.

entities.text: Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raipur, District Raipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereafter, a true copy of award was communicated to the Office on 23.09.2024.

He would submit that the Advocate appearing before the learned Claims Tribunal collected the certified copy and necessary documents including award and under Order 170 of Motor Vehicles Act and forwarded all documents to competent authority for grant approval.
He would further submit that the competent authority accorded sanction for filing appeal on 07.10.2024 and the documents were dispatched on 06.11.2024.
He would contend that the Office at Bilaspur received the documents on 11.11.2024 and thereafter it was allotted to its Advocate on 12.11.2024.

He would further contend that the appeal The New India Assurance Company Limited vs Abhishek Yadav on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119961887/
1 was preferred on 24.01.2025.

sentences.text: It is submitted by Mr. B.N. Nande that there is delay of 18 days in filing the instant appeal.
He would pray to condone it.
On the other hand, learned counsel for respondents No. 4 and 5 would oppose.
Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.
Taking into consideration the explanation offered in the application for condonation of delay, reasons assigned therein, the application is allowed.
The delay of 18 days caused in filing the instant appeal is hereby condoned.
Also heard on I.A. No. 01/2025, application for grant of stay.
Mr. B.N. Nande would submit that the deceased was pillion rider on Motorbike and the Insurance Policy was act only policy and no extra premium was given by the owner of the vehicle.
He would submit that the learned Claims Tribunal committed error of law in fastening the liability with the Insurance Company.
On the other hand, learned counsel for respondents No. 4 and 5 would oppose.
Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.
Taking into consideration the submission made by Mr. B.N. Nande, a strong case is made out for grant of stay.
The appellant/Insurance Company is directed to deposit entire amount of compensation but the claimants are hereby restrained to withdraw the same, till final disposal of this appeal.
Post this matter in the week after next.

Sd/-
(Rakesh Mohan Pandey) Judge vatti The New India Assurance Company Limited vs Abhishek Yadav on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119961887/
